elylang.bienvenida: You received the Heart Amulet. Ely watches you from the trees.
elylang.genero.pedir: Ely has no fixed form yet. Which gender do you want for your companion?
elylang.genero.invalido: Invalid gender. Use femenino, masculino or neutro.
elylang.presentacion.femenino: I am Ely, guardian of this forest. I have been here since before you arrived.
elylang.presentacion.masculino: I am Ely, guardian of this forest. I have been here since before you arrived.
elylang.presentacion.neutro: I am Ely, spirit of this forest. I have been here since before you arrived.
elylang.cierre: You close the dialogue. Ely stays there, in case you come back.
elylang.menu.ayuda: Actions: /ely picar · minar · proteger · flor · caricia · intimidad
elylang.nodo.raiz: I am glad you are here. What would you like to talk about?
elylang.nodo.saludo: Every time you return the world feels warmer. I have been looking after your things while you slept.
elylang.nodo.cuidado: Nobody had ever asked me that before… you. You take care of me. Stay a little longer, will you?
elylang.nodo.bosque: The trees whisper your name when you walk by. I tell them to be quiet, but they never listen.
elylang.nodo.arbol: I already did. It grew right where I buried the first flower you gave me. One day I will show you the way.
elylang.nodo.pasado: I have guarded this forest long before you arrived. I was alone… and then you lit a torch at midnight and spoke to me as if I were someone.
elylang.nodo.nosotros: We are… whatever you want to call it. I call it «my favourite person in the whole world».
elylang.nodo.futuro: I want to watch sunrises with you. I want a house, a garden and two beds. Well… or one.
elylang.nodo.adios: Do not take long, okay? I will be waiting by the campfire.
elylang.nodo.fin: Ely smiles and looks away so you cannot see them blush.
elylang.opc.raiz.5: What are we, you and I?
elylang.opc.raiz.6: What do you want for the future?
elylang.opc.raiz.7: I just wanted to see you
elylang.opc.saludo.1: Thank you for looking after me
elylang.opc.bosque.1: Do you talk to them about me?
elylang.opc.bosque.3: I like that they talk about me
elylang.opc.arbol.1: I will see it with you
elylang.opc.pasado.3: I do not remember that night
elylang.accion.picar.ok: Ely chops %d logs and the wood falls at your feet.
elylang.accion.picar.vacio: No logs nearby. Get closer to a forest.
elylang.accion.minar.ok: Ely digs a tunnel and hands you %d ores.
elylang.accion.minar.vacio: No ores nearby. Go a little deeper.
elylang.accion.proteger.ok: Ely stands in front of you. The air smells of ozone and flowers.
elylang.accion.flor.ok: You give Ely a flower. They tuck it behind their ear without a word.
elylang.accion.caricia.ok: You brush a strand of hair from their face. Ely is speechless.
elylang.accion.intimidad.ok: Ely hugs you and the world goes quiet.
elylang.accion.intimidad.despertar: Morning comes. Ely looks at you as if you were the only thing that matters.
elylang.error.afinidad: Ely does not trust you enough yet (needs affinity 80).
elylang.error.noche: Ely only wants that at night. Wait for sunset.
elylang.error.adulto: First confirm with /ely adulto that you are 18 or older.
elylang.error.espera: Ely needs to rest for a while.
elylang.amuleto.devuelto: Ely hands you back the Heart Amulet.
elylang.adulto.confirmado: Confirmed: 18 or older. Ely looks at you with more trust.
